name: index-options-grid-spy-30-45-lightgbm-vix-hpo
notes: ADR-0043 per-fold re-tune of the lightgbm-vix rung on this cell: hpo-grid over the rung's own knobs, objective the val twCRPS, one exhaustive search per fold. This MEASURES the tuning procedure (the summary reports per-fold winners and how many were distinct); it is not a deployment estimate. Ship a winner by pinning it into the cell document (hash moves by design). The condor report, chain and backtest are left out: the winner-consistency rule re-runs every consumer of the model with the winner, and those nodes belong to the frozen document. Generated by index_options.grid.hpo_document; never edit this file.

underlying.notes: SPY raw daily closes with each ex-date's dividend_amount (the optionshist index_daily stream, ADR-0187). since_ms is 1999-11-01 UTC midnight: the first row after the last split, because raw prices are the strike basis and the reader refuses a flagged split.

vix.notes: VIX closes, keyed by date in vix_by_date for the join.

vix_by_date.notes: dskit keyby: {date: VIX close}, the side table the join reads (one close per date; a repeated date refuses).

market.notes: Same-date VIX close as iv_index for every underlying: VXN and RVX start only in 2009-09, and the S&P 500's implied vol is the proxy scale feature (ADR-0187); the implied book prices from each underlying's own chain iv instead. A date VIX lacks keeps iv_index null.

rv.notes: HAR-style daily/weekly/monthly realized vol, backward-only. rv_22 is the reference scale; all three are inputs for a later HAR rung.

labels.notes: ln(S_t+h / S_t) over h = 22 sessions, the bucket's label horizon (the sessions its lower DTE bound spans, ADR-0187); the embargo covers its calendar reach. Rows whose horizon runs past the data keep a null label.

fwd.notes: Realized per-step vol over the same 22 sessions as the label: the target a scale rung regresses on. Every rung of a cell shares this pipeline.

model.notes: The LightGBM scale rung with log VIX added to the HAR features: nonlinear interactions of realized and implied vol.

score.notes: Locked A0002 scores: twCRPS on the strike zones |z| in [0.5, 2.5], Brier at the candidate strikes, PIT KS and Berkowitz. Val labels overlap (21-step horizon on daily rows), so the p-values are diagnostics, not tests.

search.notes: The space addresses the model's OWN knobs only (ADR-0044: fit_split is never searchable). A list value is exhaustive; add n_trials to subsample it. Lower twCRPS is better, so select is min.

walkforward.notes: Expanding train windows on session rows; 18 yearly validation windows from 2008-01-01 (the archive's chains begin there for SPY). embargo_days = dte_max + 7 = 52 covers both the label's reach (22 sessions spanned at most 39 calendar days over 1999-2025, closures included) and the settlement's reach (45 days), so no train label or settlement reaches past the validation cut.
